stem: Why is John Paul Jones remembered as the “Father of the American Navy”?

options.label: A
options.text: He won naval victories against the British during the Revolutionary War.

options.label: B
options.text: He led the naval assault against the Barbary States.

options.label: C
options.text: He commanded the first steam-powered warship in the U.S. Navy.

options.label: D
options.text: He served as the first Secretary of the Navy.
